sections.heading: First Hour After Birth (Golden Hour)
sections.content: Place baby skin-to-skin immediately after birth. This helps with bonding and initiates breastfeeding. Baby will naturally search for the breast.
tips: Skin-to-skin contact for at least 1 hour
Don't worry if milk doesn't come immediately
Colostrum (first milk) is enough for baby

sections.heading: First Few Days (0-3 days)
sections.content: Baby's stomach is very small (size of a cherry). Colostrum, the first thick yellowish milk, is perfect nutrition. Feed on demand, 8-12 times per day.
tips: Let baby feed 10-15 minutes per breast
Normal to lose some weight initially

sections.heading: First Week (3-7 days)
sections.content: Milk comes in around day 3-5. Breasts will feel full and heavy. Baby should have 6-8 wet diapers and 3-4 dirty diapers per day.

sections.heading: Islamic Sunnah
sections.content: Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) emphasized breastfeeding for 2 years. Quran mentions breastfeeding as a mother's right and baby's need.
sections.reference: وَالْوَالِدَاتُ يُرْضِعْنَ أَوْلَادَهُنَّ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ (Mothers shall breastfeed their children for two complete years) - Surah Al-Baqarah 2:233

ageGroups.title: Exclusive Breastfeeding/Formula
ageGroups.description: Only breast milk or formula. No water, juice, or solid foods needed.
tips: Feed on demand, watch for hunger cues
Growth spurts at 2 weeks, 6 weeks, 3 months

ageGroups.title: Introduction to Solid Foods
ageGroups.description: Continue breastfeeding while introducing pureed foods. Start with single ingredients.
firstFoods: Rice cereal mixed with breast milk
tips: Introduce one food at a time (3-day rule)

ageGroups.title: Expanding Food Variety
ageGroups.description: Introduce thicker textures and finger foods. Continue breastfeeding.

ageGroups.title: Family Foods
ageGroups.description: Baby can eat most family foods, chopped into small pieces. Transition to cup drinking.

ageGroups.title: Toddler Diet
ageGroups.description: Can eat all family foods. Continue breastfeeding as long as desired (Sunnah recommends up to 2 years).

sections.heading: First 40 Days (Nifas Period)
sections.content: Focus on rest, recovery, and bonding with baby. Accept help from family. This is a special time in Islam.
tips: Rest as much as possible - sleep when baby sleeps
Avoid heavy lifting and strenuous activity
sections.islamicNote: During nifas (postpartum bleeding), you are excused from prayer. Make dhikr and dua instead.

sections.heading: Nutrition for Breastfeeding
sections.content: Eat well to produce good milk and recover your strength. Islamic tradition recommends dates and specific foods.
foods: Dates - Sunnah food, rich in iron
Chicken and meat - protein for recovery

sections.heading: Emotional Well-being
sections.content: Postpartum emotions are normal. Hormones are adjusting. Reach out for support if feeling overwhelmed.
tips: Talk to your spouse and family
Don't hesitate to ask for help
Consult doctor if feeling very sad or anxious
sections.dua: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ (O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity except You, upon You I have relied)

topics.heading: Bathing Baby
topics.content: Wait until umbilical cord falls off (1-2 weeks). Give sponge baths until then.
steps: Clean face first with plain water
Wash body gently with baby soap
topics.frequency: 2-3 times per week is enough for newborns

topics.heading: Diaper Changing
topics.content: Change diapers frequently to prevent rash. Say 'Bismillah' and make baby comfortable.
tips: Clean thoroughly with wipes or water
Apply diaper cream if rash appears

topics.heading: Sleep Safety
topics.content: Always place baby on back to sleep. Room should be comfortable temperature.
tips: Firm mattress, no pillows or toys
topics.islamicNote: Recite Ayat al-Kursi and the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah for protection

topics.heading: Umbilical Cord Care
topics.content: Keep cord stump clean and dry. It will fall off in 1-3 weeks.
tips: Clean base with water if dirty
Don't pull it off - let it fall naturally
Call doctor if red, swollen, or smelly

topics.heading: When to Call Doctor
topics.content: Trust your instincts. Call if you're worried. Better safe than sorry.
urgentSigns: Not feeding well or very lethargic
Fewer than 6 wet diapers in 24 hours

practices.name: Adhan in Baby's Ear
practices.description: Recite Adhan in right ear and Iqamah in left ear shortly after birth
practices.wisdom: Baby's first words heard are about Allah's greatness

practices.name: Tahnik (Date Softening)
practices.description: Soften a date and rub it on baby's palate
practices.timing: Shortly after birth or on first day

practices.name: Shaving Hair on 7th Day
practices.description: Shave baby's birth hair and give charity equal to hair's weight in silver

practices.name: Aqiqah (Sacrifice)
practices.description: Sacrifice 2 sheep for boy, 1 for girl on 7th day
practices.purpose: Gratitude to Allah, feed the poor

practices.name: Good Name
practices.description: Choose a meaningful Islamic name within 7 days
practices.importance: Child will be called by this name on Day of Judgment

practices.name: Circumcision (Boys)
practices.description: Recommended on 7th day or shortly after
